description: Defines the ColorSpace class and related functionality for color space conversions, including creation, transformation, and lookup table generation within the Android graphics framework.

classes.name: ColorSpace
classes.description: Represents a color space with methods for conversion between RGB and XYZ, including transfer functions and primaries.

classes.name: ColorSpaceConnector
classes.description: Facilitates transformation between two ColorSpace instances.

methods.name: fromLinear
methods.description: Encodes a linear RGB value using the color space's transfer function.

methods.name: toLinear
methods.description: Decodes an encoded RGB value to linear space using the color space's transfer function.

methods.name: xyzToRGB
methods.description: Converts XYZ to RGB in the color space.

methods.name: rgbToXYZ
methods.description: Converts RGB to XYZ in the color space.
